scientific_reason: The definition of a complete ordered field does not prove completeness of the constructed reals. The established real Cauchy-completeness theorem states both Cauchy convergence and the complete ordered-field conclusion, and the established Cauchy-real LUB corollary explicitly states existence of suprema. These actual Statements now supply the two uses. The original integer-radius and uniform absolute-tail reasoning remains valid componentwise, and the bounded nonnegative energy/moment cube integrals converge by the stated LUB property. No choice principle, field smoothness, packet restriction, potential convention, integrability claim or SI qualification was changed.
